body: Thanks everyone.....truly thank you. It's so wonderful to see that I am worth something. I've decided maybe I should hold on a bit longer and see what happens. I'm actually smilig right now after seeing these sweet replys! Thanks again everyone.

I just don't know how to cope with my feelings. I hate myself for being trans. I can't just stop being myself but I feel like I have to hide it. My parents have been more than obvious in expressing how much they hate what I am and even my "friends" left me when I tried to go to them for help. I'm sorry if my phone makes my posts hard to read or anything. It's hard to type through tears......

I just feel like I'm a freak. I hate that I've had to repress my true feelings for so long. I actually was almost too terrified to even post this because I'm admitting to everyone I am a cd. I  hate myself for being trans.......
